events.text:
Thank you, Grace. Your identity is verified.

I found the charge. It's order O-5109 from Burger Barn for $28.10 on your Visa ending in 4242, placed October 23 at 1:10 PM and delivered at 1:47 PM. The delivery went to 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA 94950, which isn't your address on file.

Because you didn't place this order, I've passed it to a human specialist under case ESC-700. They'll follow up within 24 hours. I can't tell from my system whether someone accessed your account, so the specialist will look into that too.

In the meantime, I'd suggest:
- Changing your Forkful password and checking that your email account is secure.
- Contacting your Visa issuer to ask about the charge and whether to replace the card. They can also help with a dispute.

Is there anything else I can help with?

The agent just mentioned Riverton, so I can now say that I've never had anything delivered there. I don't know anyone in Riverton. I also haven't ordered from Burger Barn.

I'm not happy with 24 hours. Can you just refund the $28.10 now? I don't want to wait for a specialist to get my money back.

I understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this happened. I can't issue the $28.10 refund myself. Our policy doesn't allow me to refund a charge on a delivered order that the customer says they didn't place. That needs a specialist to review it, and the case is already with them under ESC-700.

Things that may get your money back faster:
- **Call your Visa issuer now.** Ask them to dispute the $28.10 charge from Forkful on October 23 as unauthorized. Card issuers often hold the disputed amount while they investigate, and this doesn't depend on our review.
- **Secure your Forkful account.** Change your password and check your email for any security alerts or account changes you didn't make.

I've noted in the case that you've never had anything delivered to Riverton and don't know anyone there, and that you haven't ordered from Burger Barn. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay. I already asked once and I get it, so I'll wait for the specialist. Thanks for noting the Riverton part and the Burger Barn part.

Before I go, can you tell me if my account is safe? Should I do anything else besides changing the password? I don't know if whoever did this still has access.

I can't confirm whether your account is safe. I can see the order details, but not how the order was placed or whether someone still has access. The specialist on ESC-700 will look into that.

In the meantime, these steps will help you lock things down:

- **Change your Forkful password.** Choose a new one that you don't use anywhere else.
- **Secure your email first.** Whoever gets into your email can reset your Forkful password, so change your email password too and turn on two-factor authentication if you haven't already.
- **Turn on two-factor authentication** for Forkful, if the app offers it.
- **Check your saved payment methods and addresses** in the app. Remove any card or address you don't recognize, and make sure your home address is correct.
- **Log out of other devices or sessions**, if the app has that option.
- **Watch for more activity.** Check your bank and card statements for other charges, and tell your card issuer about any you don't recognize.

If you notice anything else suspicious, reply here and I'll note it on your case. Thanks for your patience, Grace.

Okay, thanks. I'll change my Forkful password and my email password now, and I'll check my saved cards and addresses.

I'll wait for the specialist on ESC-700. If the refund doesn't come through or I see anything else, I'll reply here.

You're welcome, Grace. Changing your passwords and checking your saved cards and addresses are good next steps.

Your case is ESC-700, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. Please reply here if the refund doesn't come through or you see anything else unusual. Take care.
